reviews.text: A warm welcome, kindness, helpfulness, and professionalism were all present. Swany and Mistinguette thank you.

The veterinary team is amazing, and Dr. Guillet is very empathetic; it's clear this team loves animals ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️
P.S.: I saw a comment accusing the doctor of not being patient or gentle and saying their cat was stressed. On the contrary, I find him very gentle and patient, and my cat adores him. Honestly, I love my three cats more than anything in the world, so if the doctor were truly rushed and lacking in gentleness, I wouldn't take them there. So, I repeat, this team is truly the best ❤️❤️❤️🥰🥰🥰
Excellent!

I absolutely do not recommend this vet. He only cares about money! Yes, sir, and besides, there's no point in responding to the review... isn't it like telling me my dog ​​will get his teeth cleaned for between 250 and 450 euros without even looking at his teeth because you're afraid of them?

Yes, yes, sir, since 2023 you haven't looked into the reason why, because only I, his owner, can see them!!!
You have no love for animals. As a result, you've lost a client!

In Marseille for a few days, my little dog was unwell.
After an appointment arranged by a lovely young woman, we were seen by
a competent,
friendly veterinarian who
truly loves animals, which is unfortunately not always the case.
A thousand thanks to this team.

We live in a society where people who've never opened a book on veterinary medicine in their lives feel entitled to leave negative reviews... anyway...
The doctor is very conscientious, readily available, attentive, and highly professional.

And the assistant provides a welcome of unparalleled kindness and warmth.
My old cat has been a regular patient there for years, and it's been excellent for his well-being. Thank you.

A practice with top-notch vets. Very professional and empathetic. The vet was able to diagnose and treat my cat after just one visit. The instructions and advice provided were very clear and relevant. There's parking available in front of the practice in private spaces. A truly excellent practice; I highly recommend it.

Awful vet! He sounded very stressed on the phone and clearly told me to "go see another vet," all for a simple request for an identification card.

I definitely wasn't going to leave my dog ​​in the hands of this anxiety-inducing man! Change professions.

Response to the vet: I never refused to show you my animal, since I brought her in that very morning. I fully understood your procedure and agreed to an appointment to pick up an application form for an identification card, knowing full well that I had to bring my pet in to be identified (makes sense!). However, you weren't clear when I asked if this visit would cost me the price of a consultation, even though the I-CAD representative on the phone clearly stated that applying for an identification card is free and doesn't require an appointment. You basically told me to go somewhere else; I'll remember that.
Best vet in Marseille, attentive and humane above all.

A huge thank you to Dr. Guillet and his assistant Sasha who guided us through the process of sending our cats to Egypt. The clinic team was incredibly kind and caring in guiding us through the necessary steps. Thanks to them, our cats were able to leave in the best possible conditions. A big thank you to you, Doctor, and to Sasha for your kindness :) The cats are doing wonderfully! Carla and Pablo

Maxou is being treated by Dr. Guillet.
Max is diabetic, but he manages his diabetes very well thanks to the doctor.
The substitutes I've met are also very good.
I could find someone closer to home, but I haven't been able to.
Thank you to you and your team.

A veterinarian who is always attentive, caring, and highly professional. He truly takes the time to explain treatments and reassure both the animal and its owner. I have complete confidence in him!

The team of assistants is also fantastic; they know how to act and advise owners in the best way, and take excellent care of our companions.
I know my cat is in very good hands here. Thank you for your kindness and your passion for animals!

The vet refused to microchip my cat, claiming it was too painful to do without sedation given his age. I believe he should have informed me of this before the appointment to avoid me taking time off work for nothing, and contrary to what you claim, your assistant didn't. Furthermore, I wanted my cat microchipped first, then vaccinated later for financial reasons. I would have appreciated not feeling all this condescension and not hearing that €70 wasn't much… I brought my cat in on a harness, as I had for all previous appointments. Disappointed, I changed vets, and my cat was successfully microchipped, without sedation, without pain, and without judgment. He was even able to get vaccinated the following month.

I take my cat to this veterinary clinic. The premises are clean and spacious. The vet and his team are very attentive, welcoming, efficient, and competent—everything you could wish for your four-legged companions. I highly recommend them.

Great vet and the assistants are lovely!
Thank you for everything
Excellent contact with Dr. Guillet for my Dutch Shepherd, who was suffering from an injury sustained by another dog. He is attentive and understanding; I recommend him without hesitation.

"Where did your cat come from?" "Tunisia." "Oh, well, I guess he came in illegally then." "No, why do you say that? We got all his paperwork done." "Yes, we know your doctors over there, Algeria, Morocco, Africa..."
End of quote.

My two dogs have been patients for a little over two years, ever since we moved to the neighborhood.

We have always been very well received, and my furry friends have been treated with the utmost patience, kindness, and compassion. My youngest dog died in an accident at two and a half years old in another region, and I asked to have his ashes repatriated to our usual veterinarian. There again, both the vet and his assistant showed tremendous humanity, kindness, and support. We had time to grieve and process the loss, and they must have found such heartfelt words during that difficult time.
I wanted to take this opportunity to thank you sincerely for all the excellent care you provide to our furry friends and for all the support you show us, their humans. 🙏 I highly recommend you.
The team is always attentive and caring. I've been taking my cat to this clinic for over two years and I'm very happy with them.

As a new patient at the clinic for the care of my two cats, I was delighted by the kindness, professionalism, and patience shown by the veterinarian and his assistant. Pleasant and competent, I highly recommend them!
Great, they even called us in the evening to see how the dog was doing! Thank you!

I went there for little Pépette, and I was able to see the replacement who was really very kind and caring. We received a very warm welcome, and the care process was very clear. She and the assistant/receptionist were very attentive to the kitten's needs and our concerns. I highly recommend them! 🥰 …
Top vet! Quick but takes the time to explain.

I thank Dr. Guillet and his assistants for the excellent care and highly professional follow-up of my 16-year-old dog, who held a very special place in my life. I also thank them for the support and empathy they showed me.

J. CASTRO
A horror... A dreadful vet who, in my opinion, doesn't like animals and who is nothing like his predecessor or his assistant...
We've been in contact with a very good practice for two years. The veterinarians are serious and caring.

The welcome and professionalism of the veterinarian and his assistant are remarkable. They are always attentive, reassuring, and demonstrate great patience. Their rapport and dedication are immediately apparent, which inspires confidence from the moment you walk in. It's a true pleasure to see professionals so passionate about their work. I recommend this clinic without hesitation.

Dr. Guillet is a very good veterinarian, very caring towards our four-legged friends. With his assistant, we ordered his harness and leash, put it on him, and he looked so adorable.

Thank you, Dr. Guillet, Sacha and Clarisse (I hope I didn't make a mistake).

Thank you for being there for our animals, for your kindness, your work, and your helpful advice.

Julie and Balou.

Highly professional staff; welcoming, helpful, attentive, and responsive…
It's very reassuring to know that your pet is being cared for by such a dedicated and attentive team.
A very competent doctor who has been treating my animals for several years and who has excellent diagnostic skills.
Excellent vet who did a great job on my cat.
A superb team!
ERIC GUILLET "EXCELLENT VETERINARY DOCTOR💫💫💫HE SAVED MY 10-YEAR-OLD COTTON DE TULEAR DOG FROM A …
